THE PETITION FOR APPOINTMENT OF TEMPORARY CONSERVATOR OF THE PERSON AND ESTATE OF ALFRED GENTLE BROUGHT BY PAUL GENTLE, HEARD ON WEDNESDAY, APRIL 22, 2026 AT 10:30 A.M. IN DEPT 202 OF THIS COURT BEFORE THE HONORABLE JUDGE RUSSELL S. ROECA, IS HEREBY DENIED, WITHOUT PREJUDICE. THE PAPERS SUBMITTED IN SUPPORT OF THE PETITION FOR APPOINTMENT OF A TEMPORARY CONSERVATOR OF THE PERSON AND ESTATE OF ALFRED GENTLE ARE INCOMPLETE. SPECIFICALLY, THERE IS NO CAPACITY DECLARATION OR OTHER MEDICAL OPINION SIGNED BY A LICENSED HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONAL SUGGESTING MR. ALFRED GENTLE LACKS CAPACITY TO MAKE A DECISION OR TO DO A CERTAIN ACT, OR THAT THE EXISTING POWER OF ATTORNEY IS INVALID. AS TO THE REQUEST MADE ORALLY AT THE HEARING FOR A COURT ORDER REGARDING VISITATION, THERE IS NO DOCUMENTATION CURRENTLY BEFORE TO THE COURT TO SHOW THAT ANYONE, INCLUDING ANTOINE GENTLE, HAS THE AUTHORITY TO PREVENT ALFRED GENTLE FROM RECEIVING VISITORS, INCLUDING HIS SON PAUL GENTLE.
